name: Ticket triage with customer records
blurb: The same triage task, but the right queue depends on who is asking: an enterprise customer with open tickets is an escalation, a refund near contract renewal is a retention case. An external step fetches the record. A prompt that never sees it cannot get past 83%, at any length.
description: Routing where the right answer depends on who is asking: an enterprise customer with open tickets is an escalation, a refund near contract renewal is a retention case. An external step fetches the customer record before the prompts run. The labels depend jointly on the message and the record, so a prompt that never sees the record cannot get past 83% at any length - the ceiling is computed from the labelling rule, not asserted.
requires: A key for the customer records step (Build tab -> the rec node)
Fetch and freeze the step's data onto the dataset before running

modules.template:
Route this support ticket to one queue.

Ticket: {message}

Customer: plan {rec_plan}, {rec_open_tickets} other open tickets, contract {rec_contract}, {rec_renewal_days} days to renewal.

Queues: billing, refund, bug, account, shipping, other, escalation, retention.
modules.description: routes a support ticket to a queue, using the customer's record
